liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): Reviewer says the Dark Star is intense enough that it may have scared some people; Reviewer finds the Dark Star very nice [14][15][18]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): Reviewer says they love this Hard to Handle [7]
- **Me And My Uncle** (1 review): Reviewer calls Me and My Uncle great, with rough, raw PigPen and an energetic, electric Jerry [7]
- **Attics Of//My Life** (1 review): Reviewer treats the Attics as a nice bonus, wondering if it was played live fewer than twenty times [12]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: Going Down The Road Feeling Bad jam [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-05-24.136669.sbd.sirmick.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 133 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd70-05-24.sbd.hanno.6481.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 16 songs; 138 min; rated 4.2/5 by 25 [3]. Said about its sound: Sound is okay but not great, though still very listenable; Recording has a hum, and it sounds like a cable unplugging or levels peaking; Sound is okay at first, but the mix degrades toward Lovelight [7][9][10][12][13][15]
- **gd1970-05-24.135716.sbd.phillips.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 139 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1970-05-24.135803.sbd.phillips.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 144 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [4]

## Around the show

- Reportedly the Dead were a warm-up act, travelling from London to fill a 4:30 afternoon slot [10]
- Attendee recalls seeing the band for the first time in Europe at a festival, a hot day turning mild at night [18]
- Held at Lower Finney Green Farm, Leycett, as part of the Hollywood Festival; billed as first European performance [1]
- Sunday festival lineup included Demon Fuzz, Black Sabbath, Quintessence and Colosseum [1]
- Unlike some 1970 shows, it isn't weakened by experimental new songs that fail to work [13]
- Reviewer thinks the rest of the show is weaker than many 1970 shows, calling it average [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-05-24.136669.sbd.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: sbd > reel master > cassette > dat (48k) [1]. Also: Recording was provided by an anonymous source [1]
- **gd70-05-24.sbd.hanno.6481.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Hanno Bunjes and Uli Tete; source: Soundboard patched with Audience [3]
- **gd1970-05-24.135716.sbd.phillips.flac16**: taped by Simon Phillips; source: MSR > CDR > PC > my edits in Goldwave > CDR > FLAC; patched with unknown MR > cassette > PC and with shnid 6481 [2]
- **gd1970-05-24.135803.sbd.phillips.flac16**: transferred by Simon Phillips; source: MSR > CDR > PC > my edits in Goldwave > CDR > FLAC; patched with unknown MR > cassette > PC; further patched with shnid 6481 [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Newcastle-Under-Lyme - May 24, 1970](https://www.dead.net/show/may-24-1970) [20]
